messages.subject: Question involving integrate_ode
parts:
Hi,

I am currently starting to play with Stan for the purposes of pharmacokinetic modeling. I've done some basic models - single patient IV bolus using both an explicit solution and using integrate_ode; multiple patient (so hierarchical model) IV bolus using an explicit solution; but have become stuck when trying to do a hierarchical model using integrate_ode.

Code is attached; this is run using RStan 2.6.0 on 64-bit R 3.1.2 (sessionInfo below) on a 64-bit Windows 8.1 system. As noted, I can run a simple example just fine. But the attached code fails, but I get what looks like a make file error; specifically:
